content: Yesuꞌa neꞌyaꞌmo alino faefu tauseniꞌa vayaꞌmo apamiꞌniya gemae
Henagaꞌamo Yesuꞌa ani kotuꞌmo agiꞌamo Galeliya ani kotuꞌmo lakaeno mugagayaga faligamo uꞌniye. Ani ani kotuꞌmo alu agiꞌamo Taipiliyasi ani kotuꞌmae.
Agaemo alagena kavaꞌmo huno kaita hapauꞌniya vayaꞌaina alino hapageno apateꞌnigeꞌa ageꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo asole vayaꞌmo akame huꞌa uꞌnae.
Yesuꞌe geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌeꞌmo mago aise avefiꞌmo haiꞌa maiꞌnae.
Pasova hopa afinaꞌmo ago alagi eno hogo huꞌniye.
Yesuꞌa alino maku huno apakeyana asole vayaꞌmo agaetegamo neꞌageno apaketeno Filipifeꞌmo, mani asole vayaꞌmo neꞌagi neꞌyaꞌmo nesaya yaꞌmo haiyatetiꞌmo miya faigune, huno afi geꞌniye.
Agaiꞌamo ani hisiya kavaꞌmo ago ageꞌniyana Filipifeꞌmo na agufa gemo hisifi, huno avataga huno afi geꞌniye.
Filipiꞌa, tu hataleti kinaletiꞌmo neꞌyaꞌmo miya faigunana mani asole vayaꞌmogi nesaya kavaꞌmo osugiye, huno ha paiꞌniye.
Mago vekamo geꞌamo neꞌafiya vekamo agiꞌamo Eꞌnaluꞌa Saimoni Pita aganaꞌamoꞌa,
mago manile maiꞌniya mafaꞌnemoꞌa faefuꞌa mali peleti mayaꞌe lole noyamelaꞌeꞌmo aliꞌniye. Aliꞌniyaꞌmonanafa asole vayapiꞌmogeno mani neꞌyaꞌatomoꞌa kanale osugiye, huno ha paiꞌniye.

Yesuꞌa, etapa kahauleꞌmo itopaleꞌmo maiyo, huta hapa paiyo, huno hapa paiꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo muki vayaꞌaifeꞌmo hapa paiꞌnageꞌa kahauleꞌmo eꞌa itopaleꞌmo maiꞌnae. Ani vayaꞌmo faefu tauseniꞌa vayaꞌmo maiꞌnae.
Yesuꞌa peleti mayamo aliꞌneno Gotifeꞌmo hao ke heteno maiꞌnaya vayaꞌmo alino fako huno apamiteno noyameꞌeꞌmo ani kava huno alino apakaiꞌapimo hapauꞌniya agufa kavaꞌmo huno apamiꞌnigeꞌa aliꞌa neꞌnae.
Neꞌyaꞌmo neꞌa apamu hutagenoꞌaeꞌmo Yesuꞌa geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo, fiku yanageno neꞌya atupaꞌamo lageso hugiyanagi alita anupa hiyo, huno hapa paiꞌnigeꞌa
faefuꞌa peleti mayafatiꞌmo neꞌa apamu huteꞌa ataleꞌnaya atupamo aliꞌa tuolofuꞌa honafa yuvapafiꞌmo maleꞌa havai teꞌnae.

Apakaemo ageꞌnayana Yesuꞌa noꞌagaya agufa aune kavaꞌmo huno alino apave liꞌnigeꞌa ageteꞌapaeꞌmo, Gotitegati gemo alinineno aeno hakalo huno hapa paisiya vekamo ma mopafiꞌmo afole aigiye, huꞌa huꞌnaya vekamo agaekeꞌmae, huꞌa huꞌnae.
Ani vayaꞌmogimo eꞌa Yesuꞌmo atafauꞌa yagaino apatesiya kini vekamo aliꞌa hamaleꞌa atesayafeꞌmo huꞌnageno Yesuꞌa apakeꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo apataleno agaiꞌageꞌmo avefiꞌmo uno haiꞌniye.
Yesuꞌa ani agotofuleꞌmo eꞌniya gemae

Yegemo lamino faleꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo Yesu geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌmo ani kotutegamo lamiꞌa sipifiꞌmo haiꞌa maiteꞌa mugagayaga faliga Kapeneyamu taonifilagamo aniꞌmo lakaeꞌa visayafeꞌmo neꞌvagenoꞌaeꞌmo hani huꞌniyana Yesuꞌa apakaetegamo oꞌmeꞌniye.
Lusi kava huno yasimo alinineno aniꞌmo aino holakau holakau huꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo
apakaemo latapa kayotetiꞌmo aniꞌmo avaleꞌa ataleme ataleme aise afagiꞌaleꞌmo neꞌuꞌapaeꞌmo agayana Yesuꞌa ani agotofuleꞌmo sipi haopaleꞌmo eꞌnigeꞌa ageteꞌapaeꞌmo koli nehagenoꞌaeꞌmo
Yesuꞌa, nagaemo neꞌovanagi koli osiyo, huno hapa paiꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo
hapauꞌnigeꞌa sipifiꞌmo avaleꞌa ateteꞌapaeꞌmo malage huꞌa uꞌa ani agiꞌnaleꞌmo avaꞌyi huꞌnae.
Yesufeꞌmo kahauya huꞌnaya gemae
Egaꞌamo mugagayaga faliga vayaꞌmogi agayana egamo haneꞌnigeꞌa ageꞌnaya sipigeꞌmo magokeꞌageꞌmo haneꞌnigeno Yesuꞌa ani sipifiꞌmo oꞌuꞌnigeꞌa geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌageꞌmo uꞌnageꞌapa apakeꞌnae.
Magoꞌe sipimo Taipiliyasi kotegatiꞌmo eꞌa Yesuꞌa neꞌyaꞌmo alino Gotifeꞌmo hao ke heteno apamiꞌnigeꞌa neꞌnayategamo eꞌnae.
Asole vayaꞌmogi apakayana Yesuꞌe geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌeꞌmo anileꞌmo oꞌmaiꞌnageꞌa apaketeꞌapaeꞌmo mago sipigopiꞌmo uꞌa haiꞌa maiteꞌa Yesufeꞌmo kahauya huꞌa agesayafeꞌmo aniꞌmo lakaeꞌa uꞌnae.
Yesuꞌa afaꞌa maisaya yaꞌmo alino neꞌapamiya peleti mayagana huno maiꞌniya gemae
Ani kotuꞌmo mugagaya faligamo lakaeꞌuꞌa avaꞌyi huteꞌa Yesuꞌmo maiꞌnigeꞌa ageteꞌapaeꞌmo, Tisao, huꞌa, hainu afinaꞌmo manileꞌmo eka maiꞌnane, huꞌa afi geꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo

Yesuꞌa, alagi lama ge lapa nepauve, huno, noꞌagaya agufa aune kavaꞌmo agetapa aeto huꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo nagesayafeꞌmo oꞌmeꞌnafa peleti mayamo aliꞌna lapamiꞌnogetapa netapa lapamu huꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo nagesayafeꞌmo eꞌnae.

Lapakaemo kasalisiya neꞌyaꞌmo alisayafekeꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌmo oꞌalitapa hanege hanege huno hanesiya neꞌyaꞌmo alino lapamisigetapa alagepa hutapa maige maige hutapa maisaya yaꞌmo alisayafekeꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌmo aliyo. Vemo Mafaꞌnemoꞌa ani agufa neꞌyaꞌmo alino lapamigiye. Muki yaꞌmo Afoꞌamoꞌmo Gotiꞌa lekana paiꞌna ateꞌnove, huno alino apave lisiyafeꞌmo himamuꞌamo alino amiꞌniye, huno hapa paiꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo,
Gotiꞌa hauꞌniya kavaꞌmo hisunafeꞌmo na agufa aliꞌya na agufa aliꞌyaꞌamo aligune, huꞌa afi geꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo,
Gotiꞌa hauꞌniya kavaꞌmo magokeꞌageꞌmo haneꞌniyana alino ateꞌnigeno emineꞌniya vekaeꞌmo lapakesa afitapa fatago hisaya kavakeꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌamo haneꞌniye, huno hapa paiꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo,
Lama ge nehane, huta hisunafeꞌmo haiya agufa noꞌagona kaune kavaꞌmo huka alika lave ligane. Na kava hugane.
Laginago vayaꞌmogi kaꞌme kotega mana neꞌyaꞌmo neꞌnae. Ani kavatefeꞌmo Goti mukufi gemoꞌmo, agaemo kokuꞌnapatiꞌmo peleti mayamo alino apamiꞌnigeꞌa neꞌnae, huno huꞌniye, huꞌa ha paiꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo
Alagi lama ge lapa nepauve, Moseseꞌa kokuꞌnapati lama ge peleti mayamo alino oꞌapamiꞌnifa Afoꞌnimokeꞌmo kokuꞌnapatiꞌmo lama ge peleti mayamo alino nelapamiye.
Gotiꞌa alino neꞌapamiya peleti mayamo kokuꞌnapatiꞌmo emineno ma mopafi vayaꞌmo afaꞌa maisaya yaꞌmo alino neꞌapamiya vekamo maiꞌniye, huno hapa paiꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo,
Ala kava nene, muki afinaꞌmo ani peleti mayamo alika lamigeta neno, huꞌa ha paiꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo,
nagaemo afaꞌa maisaya yaꞌmo alino neꞌapamiya peleti mayagana huꞌna maiꞌnove. Nagaetegamo esaya vayaꞌmo apaka otegaiye. Nagaefeꞌmo apakesa afiꞌa fatago nehisaya vayaꞌmo anifeꞌmo alagi ohapaugiye.
Ago lapa paiꞌnaeꞌmo, nageꞌnayaꞌmonanafa lapakesa afitapa fatago nosae, huꞌna ago lapa paiꞌnove.
Muki vayaꞌamo muki yaꞌmo Afoꞌamoꞌmo apavaleno namisiya vayaꞌmo nagaetegamo egae. Nagaetegamo eꞌa maiꞌnisaya vayaꞌmo aliꞌna hapafaiꞌna oꞌapatalegauve.
Ani kavatefeꞌmo nagaiꞌni nahauꞌnisiya kavaꞌmo hisuvafeꞌmo emiꞌnoꞌmeꞌnofa alino nateꞌnigeꞌna emiꞌneꞌnova vekamoꞌa hauꞌniya kavaꞌmo hisuvafeꞌmo emiꞌneꞌnove.

Muki yaꞌmo Afoꞌamoꞌmo alino nateꞌnigeꞌna emiꞌneꞌnova vekamoꞌa hauꞌniyanageꞌna muki apavaleno namiꞌniya vayapatiꞌmo magoke vekamo alagi aliꞌna apaheꞌna atalesugeno lageso hisiyafeꞌmo ohauꞌniyanageꞌna ma mopamo hano hisiya afinaꞌmo muki vayaꞌamo aliꞌna he tiꞌna apatesuvafekeꞌmo hauꞌniye.

Alino nateꞌnigeꞌna emiꞌneꞌnova vekamoꞌa hauꞌniyanageꞌa Mafaꞌneꞌamo ageꞌa aeto huteꞌapaeꞌmo muki vayaꞌamogi agaefeꞌmo apakesa afiꞌa fatago nehisaya vayaꞌmo afaꞌa maige maige huꞌa maisaya yaꞌmo aligae. Aliꞌnisageꞌna ma mopamo hano hisiya afinaꞌmo aliꞌna he tiꞌna apategauve, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Yesuꞌa, kokuꞌnapatiꞌmo emiꞌneꞌniya peleti mayagana huꞌna maiꞌnove, huno hapa paiꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo aepa faiꞌa hagalu hagalu huꞌa ge hauꞌnae.

Ge hauꞌapaeꞌmo, ani kanomo Yesuꞌa Yosefe mafaꞌneꞌamo oꞌmaiꞌnifiye. He, ani kanomo maiꞌnigeta itaꞌafoꞌalaꞌmoganimo ago anakeꞌnone. Na kava higenoꞌaeꞌmo, nagaemo kokuꞌnapati emiꞌneꞌnove, huno nehiye, huꞌa huteꞌa huꞌa faipa huꞌa ateteꞌa ge hauꞌnae.
Yesuꞌa geꞌapileꞌmo aeno atagaina huno hapa painoꞌaeꞌmo, lapakaitapimo hagalu hagalu gemo osiyo.

Magoke vekamoꞌmo agaiꞌamo nagaetegamo afaꞌa oꞌmegaiyaꞌmonanafa Afoꞌnimoꞌmo alino nateꞌnigeꞌna emiꞌneꞌnova vekamokeꞌmo ayate heno avayu hulino esigenoꞌaekeꞌmo nagaetegamo egaiye. Nagaetegamo esigeꞌnaeꞌmo ma mopamo hano hisiya afinaꞌmo aliꞌna he tiꞌna ategauve.

Gotitegati gemo alini eꞌa aeꞌa hakalo huꞌa hapa nepaiya vayaꞌmogimo Goti mukufiꞌmo avoꞌmo kaeꞌapaeꞌmo, Gotiꞌa muki vayaꞌaina alino apaya malegaiye, huꞌa avoꞌmo kae maleꞌnae. Ani gemo huꞌnayaꞌmofeꞌmo muki yaꞌmo Afoꞌamoꞌmo huꞌniya gemo afiteꞌa ageꞌnaya vayaꞌmo mukiꞌamo nagaetegamo ete ete huꞌa neꞌae.
Ani gemo huvaꞌmonanafa magoke vekamoꞌa Afoꞌnimoꞌmo oꞌageꞌniye. Gotitegatiꞌmo magoke vekamo emineꞌniya vekamokeꞌmo muki yaꞌmo Afoꞌamoꞌmo ageꞌniye.
Alagi lama ge lapa nepauve, Apakesa afiꞌa fatago nehaya vayaꞌmo afaꞌa maige maige huꞌa maisaya yaꞌmo ago aliꞌnae.
Nagaemo afaꞌa maisaya yaꞌmo alino neꞌapamiya peleti mayagana huꞌna maiꞌnove.
Lapakinago vayaꞌmogi mana peleti mayamo kaꞌme kotega maiꞌneꞌapaeꞌmo aliꞌa neꞌnayaꞌmonanafa ago faliꞌnae.
Kokuꞌnapati emineꞌniya peleti mayamo aeto agufa kanale peleti mayamo haneꞌniyanageꞌa aliꞌa neꞌnisaya vayaꞌmo alagi ofaligae.

Nagaemo afaꞌa maisaya yaꞌmo alino neꞌapamiya peleti mayamo kokuꞌnapatiꞌmo emineꞌniya peleti mayagana huꞌna maiꞌnove. Ina lagimo ani peleti mayamo aliꞌa neꞌnisafigeꞌa muki afinaꞌmo afaꞌa maige maige huꞌa maigae. Aliꞌna apamisuva peleti mayamo nagufafati nameꞌanimo haneꞌniye. Ma mopafi vayaꞌmo afaꞌa maige maige huꞌa maisayafeꞌmo nameꞌanimo aliꞌna apamiguve, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Hapa paiꞌnigeꞌa afiteꞌapaeꞌmo apakaiꞌapimo ge vaiteꞌapaeꞌmo, Ani vekamo ameꞌamo nesunafeꞌmo haiya kava huno alino lamigiye, huꞌa huꞌnae.
Yesuꞌa, alagi lama ge lapa nepauve, lapakaemo Vemo Mafaꞌnemo ameꞌaꞌe kolaꞌaꞌeꞌmo alitapa oꞌneꞌnisayana afaꞌa maisaya yaꞌmo alagi oꞌaliꞌnae.
Ina lagimo nameꞌniꞌe kolaꞌniꞌeꞌmo aliꞌa neꞌnisafigeꞌa afaꞌa maige maige huꞌa maisaya yaꞌmo ago aliꞌnayanageꞌna ma mopamo hano hisiya afinaꞌmo aliꞌna he tiꞌna apategauve.
Nameꞌanimo lama ge neꞌyaꞌmo haneꞌnigeno kolaꞌnimo lama ge aniꞌmo haneꞌniye.
Ina lagimo nameꞌniꞌe kolaꞌniꞌeꞌmo aliꞌa neꞌnisafigeꞌa nagaepiꞌmo maiꞌnageꞌna apakaepiꞌeꞌmo maiꞌnove.

Muki yaꞌmo Afoꞌamoꞌmo afaꞌa maisaya yaꞌmo aepa vekamoꞌa alino nateꞌnigeꞌna emineꞌnove. Agaemo afaꞌa maisuva yaꞌmo aepa vekamo maiꞌnigeꞌna nagufafati nameꞌanimo neꞌnaya vayaꞌmo afaꞌa maisaya yaꞌmo aepa vekaꞌapimo maiꞌnove.

Manimona kokuꞌnapatiꞌmo emineꞌniya peleti mayamo haneꞌniye. Lapakinago vayaꞌmogi neꞌnaya peleti mayagana huno ohaneꞌnifa aeto agufa kanale peleti mayamo haneꞌniye. Lapakinago vayaꞌmogi aliꞌa neteꞌapaeꞌmo ago faliꞌnayaꞌmonanafa mani peleti mayamo neꞌnisaya vayaꞌmo muki afinaꞌmo afaꞌa maige maige huꞌa maigae.
Yesuꞌa mani gemo Kapeneyamu taonifiꞌmo mono nopiꞌmo alino apaya maleꞌniye.
Geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayapatiꞌmo mago vayaꞌamo ago ataleꞌa uꞌnaya gemae
Asole vayaꞌmo geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayapatiꞌmo mago vayaꞌamo ani gemo afiteꞌapaeꞌmo, mani gemoꞌmo kana huꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo ina lagimo ani gemo afiꞌa aeto hugae, huꞌa huꞌnae.
Yesuꞌa agaiꞌa aipafiꞌmo agesa afinoꞌaeꞌmo geꞌnimo neꞌafiya vayaꞌmogi huꞌnova geeꞌmo hagalu hagalu gemo nehae, huno apaketenoꞌaeꞌmo, mani gemoꞌmo aneꞌaifiꞌmo hegekana huno nelapatafaifiye.
Agesayana Vemo Mafaꞌnemo aino atagi neno haino maisigetapaeꞌmo, na agufa yane hutapa lapakesa afigae.
Nauneꞌnameꞌmoꞌa afaꞌa maisaya yaꞌmo alino neꞌapamiye. Nagufafati nameꞌamoꞌmo lapa oꞌmaegaiye. Lapa nepauva gefiꞌmo aunemeꞌmo haneꞌneno afaꞌa maisaya yaꞌmo alino neꞌapamiya gemo haneꞌniye.

Haneꞌniyaꞌmonanafa lapakaepatiꞌmo mago vayaꞌmo apakesa afiꞌapa fatago nosae, huno hapa paiꞌniye. Yesuꞌa aliꞌyaꞌamo aepa faino aliꞌniya afinatetiꞌmo apakesa afiꞌa fatago osisaya vayaꞌe kutulu yaꞌmo alisiya vekaꞌeꞌmo ago apakeꞌniye.
Huno hapa paitenoꞌaeꞌmo, ani kavatefeꞌmo, mago vekamoꞌa nagaetegamo agaiꞌamo afaꞌa oꞌmegaiyaꞌmonanafa Afoꞌnimoꞌa fiku ha maeno amisigeno egaiye, huꞌna ago lapa paiꞌnove, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Ani gemo huno hapa paiꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo asole vayaꞌmo geꞌamo afiꞌnaya vayapatiꞌmo agaeꞌeꞌmo magoꞌe huꞌa lokaeꞌa umenitata osuꞌa ago ataleꞌa uꞌeꞌa huꞌnae.
Ataleꞌa uꞌnagenoꞌaeꞌmo Yesuꞌa tuolofuꞌa vayaꞌmo geꞌamo neꞌafiya vayaꞌaifeꞌmo, lapakaeꞌeꞌmo nataletapa ugefe nehafiye, huno apafi geꞌnigenoꞌaeꞌmo
Saimoni Pitaꞌa, Ala kava nene, huno, ina lategamo ugune. Kagae gemoꞌa afaꞌa maisaya yaꞌmo alino neꞌapamiya gemo haneꞌniye.
Hemenimo lagaemo lagesa afita fatago huteta kageꞌnonana aeto agufa vekamo Gotitegatiꞌmo emikeꞌnana vekamo maiꞌnanageta kageꞌnone, huno ha paiꞌnigeno
Yesuꞌa, nagaemo lekana paiꞌna lapateꞌnovaꞌmonanafa lapakaepatiꞌmo mago vekamo aipafiꞌmo hosu aune vekamo maiꞌniye, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Agaemo Yutasiꞌa Isakaliyoti kotega vekamo Saimoni mafaꞌneꞌaeꞌmo huꞌniye. Yutasiꞌa ani tuolofuꞌa vayapati vekamoꞌa kutulu yaꞌmo aliteno Yesuꞌmo avaleno apamisigeꞌa amagisaya vekamo maiꞌniye.
